Inspect the dataset to get its elements.
<tool_call>
{"name": "artifact.inspect", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://datasets/Al_pbe_0616.extxyz"}}
</tool_call>

Select the cheapest compatible pretrained potential with cost <= 4.
<tool_call>
{"name": "mlp.select", "arguments": {"task": "energy_forces", "elements": ["Al"], "max_cost": 4}}
</tool_call>

Evaluate it on the full dataset without fine-tuning.
<tool_call>
{"name": "mlp.evaluate", "arguments": {"model_uri": "workspace://models/registry/chgnet-0.3", "test_uri": "workspace://datasets/Al_pbe_0616.extxyz"}}
</tool_call>

The errors come from the evaluation report.
<answer>
The cheapest compatible pretrained potential is chgnet-0.3 (cost 2.6). Without fine-tuning it reaches an energy MAE of 48.78 meV/atom and a force MAE of 229.5 meV/Å on the 200 structures of workspace://datasets/Al_pbe_0616.extxyz (report workspace://reports/chgnet-0.3_Al_pbe_0616.json).
</answer>

Hold out 15% of the structures as a test set (seed 0).
<tool_call>
{"name": "code.execute", "arguments": {"script": "split_dataset", "arguments": {"dataset_uri": "workspace://datasets/Ga-N_pbe_0304.extxyz", "test_fraction": 0.15, "seed": 0}}}
</tool_call>

Select the cheapest compatible pretrained potential as the starting point.
<tool_call>
{"name": "mlp.select", "arguments": {"task": "energy_forces", "elements": ["Ga", "N"], "max_cost": 4}}
</tool_call>

Fine-tune chgnet-0.3 for 100 epochs on the training split.
<tool_call>
{"name": "mlp.train", "arguments": {"dataset_uri": "workspace://datasets/Ga-N_pbe_0304_train.extxyz", "base_model": "chgnet-0.3", "epochs": 100}}
</tool_call>

Evaluate the fine-tuned model on the held-out structures.
<tool_call>
{"name": "mlp.evaluate", "arguments": {"model_uri": "workspace://models/Ga-N_pbe_0304_train-chgnet-0.3", "test_uri": "workspace://datasets/Ga-N_pbe_0304_test.extxyz"}}
</tool_call>

All reported errors come from evaluation reports.
<answer>
Fine-tuned chgnet-0.3 on workspace://datasets/Ga-N_pbe_0304_train.extxyz; on the held-out set workspace://datasets/Ga-N_pbe_0304_test.extxyz (90 structures) the model workspace://models/Ga-N_pbe_0304_train-chgnet-0.3 has an energy MAE of 8.91 meV/atom and a force MAE of 50.1 meV/Å (report workspace://reports/Ga-N_pbe_0304_train-chgnet-0.3_Ga-N_pbe_0304_test.json).
</answer>
